subject: Bug report #3
body: Bug report. The Weapon X syringe recipe has a cooked corndog in it when it should obviously be a chimichanga. Dried Fruit Studios closed it as "working as intended" so I opened another one and they closed that as "stop opening reports." Ive opened eleven now. One of them is just a picture of Bea Arthur. Thats not a bug, I just think people should see it.
